_note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY - This file is not loaded at runtime. The actual game rules are defined in src/core/Constants.lua and accessed via src/honours/BattleTraits.lua. Update Constants.lua to change battle traits.

genericBattleTraits.name: Inspiring Leader
genericBattleTraits.description: Units within 6" of this unit can use this unit's Leadership characteristic instead of their own when taking Battle-shock tests

genericBattleTraits.name: Lethal Sharpshooter
genericBattleTraits.description: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability

genericBattleTraits.name: Melee Expert
genericBattleTraits.description: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability

genericBattleTraits.name: Tank Hunter
genericBattleTraits.description: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll

genericBattleTraits.name: Fortified Position
genericBattleTraits.description: While this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save

genericBattleTraits.name: Rapid Deployment
genericBattleTraits.description: This unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" at the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins

genericBattleTraits.name: Devastating Charge
genericBattleTraits.description: Each time this unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability

genericBattleTraits.name: Marked for Death
genericBattleTraits.description: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit to be this unit's mark. Each time this unit makes an attack that targets its marked unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1

genericBattleTraits.name: Stealth Specialist
genericBattleTraits.description: Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, if this unit is within or wholly within terrain, subtract 1 from the Hit roll

genericBattleTraits.name: Never Give Up
genericBattleTraits.description: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back

genericBattleTraits.name: Chem-enhanced
genericBattleTraits.description: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this unit

genericBattleTraits.name: Tenacious Survivor
genericBattleTraits.description: Each time a model in this unit would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 6, that wound is not lost

Space Marines.name: Tactical Precision
Space Marines.description: Once per battle, this unit can re-roll all failed Hit rolls when shooting

Space Marines.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
Space Marines.description: This unit automatically passes Battle-shock tests and can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls

Necrons.name: Reanimation Protocols
Necrons.description: Each time this unit uses its Reanimation Protocols ability, you can re-roll one Reanimation roll

Necrons.name: Quantum Shielding
Necrons.description: Improve this unit's Save characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 2+) against attacks with a Damage characteristic of 1

Orks.name: Mob Rule
Orks.description: While this unit contains 10 or more models, add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of models in this unit

Orks.name: Dakka Dakka Dakka
Orks.description: Each time this unit shoots, if it remained stationary this turn, add 1 to its ranged weapons' Attacks characteristic

notes: Battle Traits are one of three Battle Honour categories
Units gain Battle Traits when they rank up
Each Battle Trait adds +1 CP (or +2 if TITANIC)
Generic traits are available to all factions
Faction-specific traits are only available to units of that faction
